description: Bookmarks for the file being watched, in timeline order. Pass all=true for every file, or file to ask about a specific one. Each entry carries the id that bookmark_goto takes, and the `key` it is filed under — the path for a file, the disc's own identity for a disc.

all.description: Every file instead of just one.

file.description: Path or URL. Defaults to what's playing. A drive path resolves to the disc currently in it.

key.description: Exactly this identity, unresolved — from disc_list, get_status, or the `key` on a listed bookmark. Use it to reach bookmarks left under a drive letter before discs had an identity.

name: bookmark_list
